messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: CRITICAL - capacity-queue-backlog fired for service: autoscaler-infer-prod (svc_id: svc-9a3c). Alert: queue depth > 12000 for 3m, avg processing latency > 4s. Link: https://pagerduty.example/INCIDENT/PD12345 

pagerduty: PagerDuty notification: incident PD12345 created and routed to primary on-call.

jen (oncall): ack'd. I'm looking now. seeing huge backlog on infer-router queues, KV cache hit-rate dropped to 12%. GPU workers CPU fine but tasks piling in the queue.

mike (eng-sre): on it — checking autoscaler metrics. Cloud autoscaler shows no recent scale up events. HPA CPU metrics present but request-based scaler shows plateau at target_replicas=20. Something's preventing new nodes from joining: hitting provider instanceQuota in eu-west-1?

alex (platform): I see provisioning attempts failing with quota-exceeded from cloudsdk. Error logs: `InstanceQuotaExceeded: Cannot allocate requested capacity` — we hit a soft limit on p3d in that region.

jen (oncall): customers already reporting elevated 5xxs. Tom just pinged: a few enterprise customers seeing timeouts for batch embeddings. Tagging customer-impact. :exclamation:

sam (sre): quick mitigation: we can temporarily divert low-priority traffic to smaller quantized model pool to reduce load on GPU pool. Also we can manually add instances in us-west as cross-region fallback. Do we have runway to failover?

mike (eng-sre): agree. Initiating manual scale override to drain backlog and then implement routing rule to route non-prod or low-priority to hosted small-gpu pool. Running command:
```
# bump replicas to 35 to clear queue fast
redwoodctl scale --pool infer-prod-gpu --replicas 35 --reason "emergency backlog"
kubectl -n inference patch hpa autoscaler-worker --patch '{"spec":{"minReplicas":35,"maxReplicas":60}}'
```

jen (oncall): Running that now. watch logs for KV cache warmup — we might see increased cold misses and temporary latency spike.

incident-bot: Action recorded: manual scaling command executed by jen (oncall).

pagerduty: PagerDuty: incident PD12345 acknowledged by jen (oncall). Escalation timer paused.

alex (platform): Meanwhile submitting a temporary quota request to cloud support and spinning up 10 nodes in us-west as fallback. Also toggling routing: set route-policy=best-effort for embeddings.

mike (eng-sre): Also discovered an internal rate-limiter in the serving runtime that prevents more than 30 concurrent scheduling threads per node; with the current shard distribution we are hitting the per-shard ceiling and autoscaler doesn't see CPU pressure. File an infra tweak: remove the hard cap or increase per-node concurrency.

jen (oncall): After scale to 35, backlog decreased from 12k -> 2.8k in 6 minutes. 5xx rate trending down. Notifying PD and customers via ops status.

tom (customer-ops): Customer updates sent: affected customers now seeing degraded but recovering performance. One enterprise asked for ETA; told them 30-45m.

sam (sre): Re-routing complete for low-priority jobs. We should keep manual override until cloud quota confirmed. Plan: leave minReplicas=25 for now, follow up with autoscaler config change to detect queue depth metric. Raising a follow-up ticket: INFRA-6421.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: escalation unpaused. Next on-call will be notified at handoff.

dawn (handoff): taking handoff in 30m. copying action items: 1) keep manual replicas=25 2) monitor kvcache hit-rate and queue depth 3) follow up cloud quota request 4) implement autoscaler metric patch (queue depth). I'll own the postmortem.

jen (oncall): marking incident as mitigated for now. Will remain in thread during handoff. incident-bot: please annotate incident with runbook steps taken. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident PD12345 - status: mitigated (backlog reduced, manual scale in place). Please add runbook notes and tag postmortem: INFRA-6421.

mike (eng-sre): follow-ups: convert queue-depth into a primary scaling metric, add cross-region fallback automation, and address node concurrency cap. Adding owners to INFRA-6421.

jen (oncall): thanks team. leaving thread to Dawn for next shift.

dawn (handoff): ack — will monitor and kick off postmortem. Good catch on the quota & per-node cap.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: incident PD12345 updated: mitigated by manual scale and routing changes.
